description: SWEPOS is the Swedish national network of permanent GNSS reference stations run by Lantmäteriet. Its data supports navigation and accurate positioning for many GNSS applications, from real-time positioning in production, such as guidance of construction machines, to scientific studies. Services are real-time, with network RTK used for property surveying, setting out buildings, positioning of drones and precision agriculture, and post-processing, where the Efterberäkning subscription gives access to the SWEPOS computation service, virtual RINEX and RINEX data, so that users can either send static GNSS measurements for coordinate computation or download SWEPOS data to process their own. Access is through subscriptions described on the page; no price or licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is in Swedish, and the observation data is offered within the post-processing subscription, not as open downloads. Coverage is Sweden. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, including the dependence of construction, surveying and agriculture on GNSS and the effect of space weather on positioning; related records are SAPOS of Germany, ERGNSS of Spain and OS Net of Great Britain.
